create.name: Nicky Sutton
create.bio:
Nicky Sutton is a British hypnotherapist, past life regression practitioner and author, based in London, who records long-form sleep meditations. Over more than ten years she has made hundreds of recordings, some running up to twelve hours, which are heard on YouTube, Insight Timer, her own Sleep Time app and other platforms, every one voiced by her rather than by software. She came to this work after a sudden spiritual awakening of her own, which she says changed her sense of who she was.

Her recordings pair deep relaxation with spoken suggestion and visualisation, and many take spiritual themes: meeting spirit guides, opening intuition and the third eye, channelling, past lives, cutting energetic cords, shadow work and manifestation. She also makes subliminal affirmation tracks and ambient sleep sounds. Her Hay House book, Consciousness Rising (2021), follows awakening from the first upheaval through the dark night of the soul to the slow rebuilding of a steadier self, with exercises and meditations along the way. On Insight Timer she also leads a ten-day course on the law of attraction. She does not take one-to-one clients; her teaching reaches people through her recordings, the app and the book.

books.title: Consciousness Rising: Guiding You through Spiritual Awakening and Beyond
books.author: Nicky Sutton
books.description: A Hay House guide to the stages of spiritual awakening, from the first disorientation through the dark night of the soul to rebuilding a sense of self. It weaves personal stories with exercises and meditations on intuition, past lives, energy and manifesting.

courses.title: MP3 Sleep Meditation Shop
courses.description: Individual sleep hypnosis recordings and subliminal affirmation tracks to download, grouped by theme such as extrasensory development, manifesting, energy work, divination and journeys or regressions. Each is a long recording for listening at bedtime.

courses.title: The Law Of Attraction: Manifest Your Best Life
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course on how thought, belief and feeling relate to what we experience. Each day pairs a short teaching on themes such as intention, gratitude and trust with a guided practice.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Nicky Sutton on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer page carries many of her sleep meditations and affirmation tracks on intuition, manifesting and spiritual growth, free to hear.

free_resources.title: Free Sleep Meditations
free_resources.description: A page of full-length sleep meditations to play in the browser, on themes such as spirit guides, emotional balance and the law of attraction. Each runs for roughly forty minutes.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 31.2k (profile via WebFetch, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube 139k (@NickySuttonMeditations channel page, 31 Oct 2026); Instagram 9,024 (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); Facebook 7,863 (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); TikTok 2,149 (profile page followerCount, 31 Oct 2026); second YouTube channel Moon Sleep Ambience 619 → ~190k total → luminary
flags: Mainly an audio content creator (sleep hypnosis and subliminals) rather than a teacher who works with people; she has a Hay House book on spiritual awakening and an Insight Timer course, so she is kept, but a human may want to confirm fit.
The progress lead says '1:1 sessions', but her contact page says she does not offer one-to-one sessions; her contact form is for app support, course support and business enquiries.

Most of her catalogue is sleep-framed; items are chosen for spiritual themes (guides, channelling, intuition, shadow work) and sleep-problem items left out, but 'sleep hypnosis' is in many video titles.
YouTube view counts could not be read; videos picked from recent uploads as spoken sleep hypnosis with spiritual themes, not subliminal or music-only tracks.
Video 'Cutting Cords ... Release That Toxic Attachment' kept as energetic rather than clinical, borderline.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch (one sentence saved); bio check relies mainly on her own site pages.
Only one photo used: the Insight Timer profile picture is the same image as the YouTube avatar.
left_out: Videos and downloads for grief healing, cortisol reduction, circadian rhythm, parasympathetic activation and limiting-belief 'heal' wording left out (health or condition framing).
Insight Timer tracks such as the weight-loss sleep meditation in her course page listings are not listed (condition-named).
Subliminal affirmation videos (mainly music with hidden affirmations) left out as effectively music-only.
Sleep Time app subscription not listed: no app price or own offering page on her site, only an app-store link.
Moon Sleep Ambience YouTube channel (ambient sleep sounds) not used for videos.
